title: Chapter 203
text:
Frost Pine Town was a poor beginner settlement. Poor meant that there were many missions. Although the equipment of the players here was shabby, the experience points were quite high. Many players came to buy skills, and some even came to take pictures with them. Han Xiao was the center of attention. Wherever he went, there would be a crowd.

After a day, Han Xiao left Frost Pine Town, returned to the plane, and headed to the Overmera family.

Of course, he did not have a sense of belonging to his original body's family, but he could not help but be curious about his original body, so he decided to ask around. Furthermore, Alumera was still hunting for his original identity, so Han Xiao was very interested in getting in touch with them.

"The Overmera family, a warlord tycoon in the Northern Continent, has a cooperative relationship with Theseus. They have twenty-four settlements in the world, five of which are large territories. They are very rich and registered as a legal financial group in Theseus. They are involved in business and politics, and each industry is managed by different factions. There are four main factions in the Overmera. Delot Overmera's Home Faction, the Second Leader Xiao Jin's Xiao Faction, the Third Leader Se Qi's Red Island Faction, and the relatively loose Local Alliance Northern School.

"The Overmera is a warlord force formed by the forces of the fallen country. The Home Faction is in charge of the overall situation, and the other factions are under the banner. They swallowed many loose warlords and became one of the most powerful warlords in the Northern Continent. After that, they accepted Theseus' offer of amnesty and obtained an official background. In recent years, they have not made any big moves. They are basically helping Theseus solve some difficult problems, especially Raylan. "

The situation in the Northern Continent was different. It was not as peaceful as other countries. The conflict between Theseus and Raylan was very intense, and there were often bloody incidents. The soldiers, agents, and supers of the two countries fought in secret battlefields. The hatred was deeply rooted. Both Theseus and Raylan were very aggressive countries, and there was no room for two tigers on one mountain. In the twenty to thirty years since the beginning of the new era, the two countries were always trying to get rid of each other.

Until recently, when they decided to join forces to attack the Germinal Organization, the two sides finally stopped.

Han Xiao muttered, "The Overmera's headquarters is a tiger's den. Although the Overmera are afraid of my identity and strength, it is because of their large business. Strictly speaking, I am now their enemy, and we might fight."

…

A large settlement was located halfway up a snow-covered mountain range. This was the headquarters of the Overmera. It was easy to defend and difficult to attack. There were only two ways to enter the settlement. The first was through the heavily guarded mountain road. The second was to climb up the cliff on the other side of the settlement. It was also guarded.

The mountain rocks were dark green, the snow was white, and the cold wind was bone-chilling.

At the mountain pass, a sentry in a thick coat looked around. Suddenly, he saw a figure slowly approaching in the snowstorm.

"Someone is approaching!" The sentry ordered his companions to be on guard. Soon, the full appearance of the figure appeared in their sight. The sentry's face froze. It was the Black Phantom that the leaders had ordered them to pay special attention to.

Looking at the tall and heavily guarded mountain pass, Han Xiao's eyes flashed. It was indeed as the intelligence said, very heavily guarded.

He just did not know what the Overmera's attitude toward him was.

He soon had an answer to his question.

After waiting for a while, the mountain pass opened. A small team surrounded a man and walked in front of Han Xiao. The man put on a fake smile and said, "Mr. Black Phantom, welcome to the Overmera. My name is Ummil, and I am here to welcome you. Please follow me up the mountain. The leaders have been waiting for a long time."

Well, it looks like they will not start fighting immediately. Judging from the way they talk, it feels like they are going to have a banquet. Sigh, so troublesome. What can't they use the simplest and most violent means to solve it? This is not called violence, this is returning to the basics, skipping the process and going straight to the last step to save everyone's energy.

"Time is money. Sigh, since I'm already here …"

Han Technician lifted the single-shoulder backpack full of machines and followed Ummil up the mountain path.

The mountain path was shrouded in clouds as they passed through one mountain pass after another. The two of them were accompanied by guards.

Along the way, Han Xiao's face was always dark. Ummil wanted to test him many times, but he was forced to swallow his words by Han Xiao's expression. After thinking for a long time, he braced himself and said, "The leaders were very surprised to hear that you were coming to visit. After all, we had some unpleasantness not long ago."

"You are very curious about why I am here?"

"Indeed. Strictly speaking, we are not friends, but since you are here personally, I believe you are here with a friendly goal," Ummil said.

"I am here to cause trouble. I haven't chosen who to kill yet. Why don't I start with you?" Han Xiao said.

"Hehe, with your strength, why do you need to visit if you want to assassinate our middle-level officers?" Ummil's expression did not change. "This joke is not funny."

"Is it?" Han Xiao glanced at the guards beside him. These soldiers were expressionless, and their fingers never left the trigger. They had a cold and masculine posture. However, the cold sweat flowing down from their temples and their short breaths revealed that they were not as calm as they appeared to be.

The captain of the guards secretly glanced over, and Han Xiao instantly caught it. The captain was so scared that he quickly looked away.

"But they seem to find it interesting." Han Xiao smiled and patted the captain's shoulder. He could clearly feel the captain's body tense up for a moment.

Ummil smiled, but he cursed in his heart. He did not come with good intentions. He is fearless. I can't figure out his intentions.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and suddenly asked, "Ummil … that's your name, right? Which faction are you from? Home Faction or something else?"

Ummil's expression became unnatural. He coughed and said, "I am a member of the Overmera family. That's all."

Han Xiao smiled and did not say anything else.

The two were silent until the territory gate appeared in front of them.

Ummil was relieved and said, "We are here. The leaders are waiting for you in the hall."

The gate opened, and hundreds of soldiers walked out. The advantage in numbers seemed to have given them confidence. They stared at Han Xiao fiercely.

Ummil led the way at the front. He walked very slowly on purpose and stayed in the middle of the armed forces for a long time. He wanted to intimidate Black Phantom.

Han Xiaoxin knew this, but he did not care. This trick was useless against him. Suddenly, his eyes moved. He saw some floating IDs outside the crowd. There were players here.

That's right. Overmera is not far from Frost Pine Town. Some players who left the novice village have a chance to come here …

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. Since Overmera already has players, why would they send people to catch Inhumans …

There were many possibilities, but Han Xiao did not think much about it. The purpose of this trip was Overmera. It did not matter if the players were here or not.

…

"Why are these soldiers gathering?"

Far away, a dozen players stared at the crowd and discussed softly. Their IDs all had 'Bamboo Rain'. They were all members of 'Bamboo Rain', a small casual guild with only a few dozen members, and they were all young people.

The guild leader, Bamboo Rain Fragrance, was a beautiful girl with long hair. She said in surprise, "They seem to be welcoming someone. Is this an emergency?"

"Let's go and take a look. Maybe we can trigger a mission." Bamboo Rain Fly was a little handsome. After he finished speaking, he asked for the opinions of the team members.

Of course, no one objected. Only the Bamboo Rain Guild players were in this settlement. They had found this place by chance. The map sold in the novice village did not indicate this place.

The players' interface maps were all foggy. Only when they bought the map or went to the place personally would they be able to light up more places.

As they approached the crowd, Bamboo Rain Xuan exclaimed, "That's Black Phantom!"

Everyone was shocked. They looked at each other and realized that it was Black Phantom.

"Why would Black Phantom come here? And the people here seem to be hostile toward him." Bamboo Rain Fragrance frowned and said, "He was still in the novice villages a few days ago. There must be a reason why he suddenly came here."

Bamboo Rain Xuan's eyes lit up. "This is an emergency plot! Maybe there will be a hidden mission! "

"I'm lucky. I haven't seen Black Phantom before. I don't need to go to the novice village to learn skills from him."

"I remember that some of the video hosts are collecting his material."

Seeing Han Xiao walk into the hall, everyone stopped in their tracks. The hall was a high-level area that was not open to them. It required a high faction relationship. Black Phantom could enter directly, so they were helpless.
